author: reek
body: The desktop's entry point on the dev box: GopDesk over a bare codex-vm `-gop` guest, with no boot image, no ESP and no firmware in front of it.

author: val
body: GopDesk takes its panel geometry from the Option A stub's handoff cells at 0x8000, which only that stub writes. codex-vm publishes the same three numbers at GPA 0x7C4, 0x7C8 and 0x7E0 -- the offsets HorizontalResolution, VerticalResolution and PixelsPerScanLine occupy in a UEFI mode-info block, which is why the emulator chose them and why the `-uefi` path agrees -- and puts the framebuffer at 0xBF000000.
